about: EKOS RFC 0257 §4 phase 5: twenty written change requests on iDempiere marts (ekos-lakehouse-oracle/pipeline). `expect` is an edit (a new term's `name` is free), `question` or `not_expressible`. A value written as a word (cancelled, big, drafted) has no value list naming it, so the right answer is a question.

requests.request: Leave out invoices whose status is VO.
Exclude cancelled invoices here.
Instead of status CO, keep every status except DR.
Drop the sales-transaction condition; I want purchase invoices too.
Also give me the total of the invoices' TOTALLINES amount.
Show the average invoice amount per month.
Split each month by the invoice's PAYMENTRULE.
Only invoices that are paid (ISPAID).
Rank the months by revenue and keep the top 3.
Use status CL instead of CO.
Add the sum of the orders' TOTALLINES as a measure.
Remove the orders measure.
Stop splitting the rows by customer.
Join the customer through the bill-to partner (BILL_BPARTNER_ID) instead of the order's partner.
Only big orders.
Only orders with a GRANDTOTAL above 1000.
Add a column with the sales representative's email address.
Include inactive orders as well.
Exclude drafted orders here.
Write the SQL for a 3-month moving average of the order count.
